title: Conclusion
body:
Conclusion

The object and goal of life is that every human being should internally realize the divinity within himself and realize the unity with the Lord. The devotee who understands that he lacks the qualifications or the ability to follow Karma, Jnana, and Bhakti yogas as stipulated, but possesses a longing desire to be united with the Lord, has a sure and easy path laid out. All one has to do is seek out an Acharya and surrender to him with complete confidence, absolute faith, and devotion. The disciple must learn to appreciate the teachings of the Acharya and see the Acharya as an equivalent or a representative of the Lord Himself. Through being initiated by the Acharya and following his instructions, the disciple gains the fruits of dharma, artha, kama, and moksha. Ultimately, the Lord will shower his grace on such a person, granting moksham or eternal bliss.
I would like to end this journey by paying obeisance to my Acharyas and the Lord.

" Acharyan Tiruvadigale Sharanam "

pallāṇḍu pallāṇḍu pallāyirattāṇḍu pala kōṭi nūṟāyiram  
mallāṇḍa tiṇtōḷ maṇivaṇṇā! uṉsēvaḍi sevvi tirukkāppu  

aṭiyōmōdum niṉṉōḍum pirivinṟi āyiram pallāṇḍu  
vaṭivāy ninvala mārbinil
 vāzgiṉṟa maṅgaiyum pallāṇḍu  
vaṭivār cōdi valatturaiyum śudaṟāziyum pallāṇḍu  
paṭaipōr pukku muzaṅgum appāṉjaṉniyamum pallāṇḍē

कायेन वाचा मनसेन्द्रियैर्वा
बुद्ध्यात्मना वा प्रकृतेः स्वभावात् ।
करोमि यद्यत्सकलं परस्मै
श्रीममन नरायणायेतिसमर्पयामि ॥

सर्वं श्रीकृष्णार्पणम् अस्तु।।
